concerns.text: Success criterion SC-004 requires a retention check that ≥28 of the recruited ≥32 participants complete both interface blocks with at least one primary‑success trial each, but no task in tasks.md implements this check.

Success criterion SC-005 mandates measuring that the entire pipeline completes within ≤ 6 hours on CPU‑only resources. The only related task (T011) merely mocks a time‑limit decorator and does not record or verify actual runtime, leaving the requirement uncovered.
Task T000 is tagged with [US0], but the specification defines user stories only as US‑1, US‑2, and US‑3; US0 does not exist.

Tasks T001, T002, T003, T004, T005, and T006 use tags [US1], [US2], [US3] (without hyphens), whereas the spec’s user‑story identifiers are US‑1, US‑2, US‑3. These tags do not match any defined IDs and are therefore stale.
